cd "C:\Users\Kashish Gandhi\AgentControlTower" && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add repo_root transparency to prove no silent fallback in repo-scoping

The dashboard's ?repo= query param lets a request point at a repo other
than this backend's own default. Live testing already confirmed isolation
was correct at the API level (a genuinely different local repo path
returns WAITING FOR AGENT ACTIVITY with an empty agent/checkpoint list,
never this repo's own data) -- but there was no way for the UI to prove
that to the user, only to trust it.

This closes that gap: IngestionResult, AgentRegistryResult, and LiveState
now carry a repo_root field stamped with the exact resolved absolute path
main.py/sse.py actually queried, never guessed downstream. The frontend
now shows "Reading from: <server-confirmed repo_root>" instead of just
echoing back whatever the user typed.

Added backend/tests/test_repo_isolation.py (4 tests): a given repo target
is read via list_pending_checkpoints with that exact resolved path (never
settings.repo_root, the backend's own default); the response's repo_root
matches; an invalid repo target 400s without ever calling into ingestion
against the default; and the default-repo case still reports its own
repo_root correctly when no ?repo= is given.

57/57 backend tests pass; frontend builds clean with no TypeScript errors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01X8vKkFnb5HasHkULjE495x
EOF
)"
